notes: Checked: full mega-menu 'Nieuw' dropdown (a top-level Uitgelicht/Featured nav item), footer nav ('Nieuwe collectie' links to the same /nieuw page), and slug probes (/new-arrivals, /nieuw-binnen both 404). https://www.xenos.nl/nieuw (H1 'Nieuw') is a genuine PLP: embedded catalog JSON gives total_items 239, page_size 48, last_page 5 (ceil(239/48)=5, consistent). The same nav dropdown exposes two genuine child facet-filters, verified as their own real listings: /nieuw/_tn_fk_ae-category-Woonaccessoires (Home Accessories) total_items 208, last_page 5 (ceil(208/48)=5, consistent) and /nieuw/_tn_fk_ae-category-Meubels (Furniture) total_items 24, last_page 1 (ceil(24/48)=1, consistent). Recorded as parent + 2 leaves; the leaves' sum (232) does not equal the parent (239) which is expected since these are facet filters, not a strict partition (a handful of new items, e.g. Tuin/garden, fall outside both facets). Also present in the same dropdown but excluded as NOT New Arrivals: 'Woontrends' sub-menu (Pearl of Peace / Sakura Stories / Calm Chocolate) -- named designer/seasonal trend collections, a style concept rather than a 'recently added' facet; 'Herfstdecoratie' -- this is the existing Autumn Decor category merely sort-ordered by newest (?sort=Nieuw%20desc), an arbitrary sort view of an existing category per the brief's exclusion, not a distinct New Arrivals listing; 'Geurlijn: The Scent' -- a single fragrance product line, not a new-arrivals listing. Also considered and excluded: the /trending page (found via the same 'Nieuw' page's category slider) -- its own copy centers on style/trend curation rather than newness-to-catalogue, so it was evaluated for the Bestsellers extraction instead (recorded there, flagged ambiguous) and not duplicated here.
